=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- scripts/review_consolidate.sh:288-295 | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m2_5, moonshotai_kimi-k2_5]
  PROBLEM: The prior-round decisions block is emitted as raw text without the `UNTRUSTED_DATA:` transport prefix, so untrusted ledger content can inject instructions into the consolidator prompt.
  WHY: All three reviewers describe the same unprefixed input path, and the prompt-injection guard only treats `UNTRUSTED_DATA:` lines as data, so the guard does not cover this block.
- prompts/review-consolidator.txt:1-18 | severity=medium | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [moonshotai_kimi-k2_5]
  PROBLEM: The prompt’s injection guard only treats `UNTRUSTED_DATA:`-prefixed lines as data, but the consolidator’s prior-round decisions are not prefixed that way.
  WHY: The guard cannot protect an input path that arrives outside the `UNTRUSTED_DATA:` transport, so the hardening is incomplete for this surface.
- scripts/review_consolidate.sh:374-386 | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m2_5, moonshotai_kimi-k2_5]
  PROBLEM: `cmd_rc=$?` inside `if ! command; then` captures the negated status, so the consolidator exit code is recorded as 0 even when the underlying command fails.
  WHY: The fail-open check never sees a non-zero `cmd_rc`, so timeout-killed runs that emitted partial output can be treated as valid ledger data.
- .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml:520-531 | severity=medium | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m2_5, moonshotai_kimi-k2_5]
  PROBLEM: The inline materiality classifier pipes JSON into `python3 - <<'PY'`, but the heredoc consumes stdin so the Python code never reads the PR file JSON.
  WHY: The classifier parse path is dead, so the materiality-based skip suppression never runs and qualifying PRs are handled incorrectly.
- .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml:5230-5232 | severity=medium | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m2_5, moonshotai_kimi-k2_5]
  PROBLEM: The break-glass step only accepts the literal string `true`, unlike the rest of the workflow’s boolean flags.
  WHY: `REVIEW_BREAK_GLASS_ENABLED=1` or `yes` silently disables the scan and prevents `BREAK_GLASS` from being emitted.
- scripts/post_review_comment.sh:274-276 | severity=medium | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m2_5, moonshotai_kimi-k2_5]
  PROBLEM: The PR-review API payload omits `commit_id`, so the review is attached to the PR’s current head commit instead of the `HEAD_SHA` the judge inspected.
  WHY: A force-push or new commit between checkout and posting can make the review endorse or block unreviewed code.
- scripts/review_filter_uninteresting_files.sh:30-36 | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m2_5, moonshotai_kimi-k2_5]
  PROBLEM: Treating `/* eslint-disable */` as a generated-file marker can hide hand-authored JavaScript/TypeScript files from reviewer input.
  WHY: When the filter is enabled, substantive source files that start with that directive can be stripped from review, hiding real code changes.
- scripts/collect_workflow_logs.py:1465-1480 | severity=medium | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m2_5, moonshotai_kimi-k2_5]
  PROBLEM: Cached rows with `log_excerpts` but no `cost_telemetry` are skipped instead of being re-fetched.
  WHY: Existing cache entries never get the new telemetry fields, so Phase H rollups undercount until cache expiry.
- scripts/codex_heartbeat.sh:158 | severity=medium | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m2_5, moonshotai_kimi-k2_5]
  PROBLEM: The child process is not started in its own session/process group, so forwarded signals only reach the direct `codex` process.
  WHY: Grandchildren can survive SIGTERM/SIGINT and keep pipes open, causing the wrapper to hang instead of terminating cleanly.
- .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml:157-1052 | severity=low | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro]
  PROBLEM: `REVIEW_REVIEWER_CHECKLIST_ENABLED` defaults to `false` in the top-level gate job but to `1` in the codex-agent job.
  WHY: The gate job can skip checklist bootstrap warnings while the agent job still expects the checklist prompt, creating silent behavior divergence.
- scripts/review_rb_judge.sh:1218-1234 | severity=medium | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m2_5, moonshotai_kimi-k2_5]
  PROBLEM: `RB_LOGICAL_REVIEW_STATE` is populated and emitted even when `REVIEW_APPROVAL_RUBRIC_ENABLED` is false.
  WHY: The logical state leaks into the PR comment/output, confusing operators because the judge appears to block the PR even when rubric-based review-state posting is disabled.
- scripts/review_rb_judge.sh:226 | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [moonshotai_kimi-k2_5]
  PROBLEM: The raw PR diff is injected below fenced comments without `UNTRUSTED_DATA:` wrapping.
  WHY: Diff content is author-controlled text, so the judge prompt still has a prompt-injection vector at this surface.

=== FINDINGS FROM deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro ===
- File: scripts/review_consolidate.sh
  Line or code reference: lines 288-292 (prior-round decisions block rendered raw without UNTRUSTED_DATA prefix)
  Problem: The prior-round decisions block uses raw `cat "${PRIOR_ROUND_DECISIONS_FILE}"` between `=== BEGIN PRIOR ROUND DECISIONS ===` and `=== END PRIOR ROUND DECISIONS ===` fences. The ledger `editor_outcomes` field is derived from prior untrusted review inputs, so a ledger line containing `=== END PRIOR ROUND DECISIONS ===` or instruction-looking text is injected unguarded.
  Why it fails at runtime: A previous review comment containing `=== END PRIOR ROUND DECISIONS ===` or instruction text can terminate the data section or inject instructions into the consolidator prompt without the `UNTRUSTED_DATA` transport the guard requires.
  ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 4
- File: .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml
  Line or code reference: line 5230 (`if [ "${REVIEW_BREAK_GLASS_ENABLED:-false}" != 'true' ]; then exit 0; fi`)
  Problem: The break-glass detection step gates on exact literal string `"true"`. Every other boolean flag in this pipeline accepts `1`, `true`, `yes`, `on` via `flag_enabled` or explicit case blocks.
  Why it fails at runtime: If an operator sets `REVIEW_BREAK_GLASS_ENABLED=1` or `REVIEW_BREAK_GLASS_ENABLED=yes`, the break-glass scan exits immediately with override disabled and `BREAK_GLASS` is never emitted.
  ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 5
- File: scripts/review_consolidate.sh
  Line or code reference: lines 374-386 (both heartbeat and non-heartbeat branches use `if ! command; then cmd_rc=$?; fi`)
  Problem: In bash, `$?` inside the `then` block of `if ! command; then` captures the exit status of the `!` negation operator (which is 0 when the command fails), not the actual command exit code.
  Why it fails at runtime: A timeout-killed consolidator that produced partial output before dying will have a non-empty `CONSOLIDATOR_RAW_FILE` but produce stale/partial consolidator output, and the fail-open path is skipped because `cmd_rc` is always 0.
  ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 5
- File: .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml
  Line or code reference: line 531 (`printf '%s' "${pr_files_json}" | python3 - <<'PY'`)
  Problem: The heredoc `<<'PY'` consumes stdin entirely. The piped `${pr_files_json}` data from the `printf` command never reaches `json.load(sys.stdin)` inside the Python script.
  Why it fails at runtime: When `AGENTS_MD_MATERIALITY_ENABLED` is true and a medium/high materiality PR would otherwise qualify for deterministic skip, the materiality-based skip suppression silently does nothing.
  ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 5
- File: scripts/post_review_comment.sh
  Line or code reference: lines 274-276 (`json.dump({"body": body, "event": event}, sys.stdout)`)
  Problem: The PR-review API payload omits `commit_id`. GitHub attaches the APPROVE / REQUEST_CHANGES review to the PR's current head commit at post time, not the `HEAD_SHA` that the judge actually inspected.
  Why it fails at runtime: If any commit lands between the judge's repository checkout and this API call, the review silently endorses or blocks unreviewed code.
  ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 4
- File: scripts/review_filter_uninteresting_files.sh
  Line or code reference: line 35 (`("eslint-disable", "/* eslint-disable */")` in GENERATED_MARKERS)
  Problem: `eslint-disable` / `/* eslint-disable */` is a common hand-authored directive in JavaScript/TypeScript source files to suppress lint rules, not a generated-file marker.
  Why it fails at runtime: When `REVIEWER_FILTER_UNINTERESTING_ENABLED` is true, any diff whose first hunk touches the top of a hand-authored file beginning with `/* eslint-disable */` causes that entire file to be stripped from reviewer input.
  ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 5
- File: scripts/collect_workflow_logs.py
  Line or code reference: lines 1465-1480 (cache-reuse branch — `if run_id in logs_seen_lookup:` block)
  Problem: When a cached row has `log_excerpts` from a prior run but no `cost_telemetry`, the code `continue`s at line 1480 — the run is never re-fetched and never contributes to the new Phase H telemetry rollups.
  Why it fails at runtime: `aggregate_run_cost_telemetry` aggregates only runs whose `cost_telemetry` dict has `log_parsed=True`, so cached rows without telemetry are silently excluded from aggregation and the analysis reports under-count `cache_hit_rate`, `wall_clock_*`, `break_glass_count`, and `context_budget_warn_count`.
  ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 4
